Confirmed: `docs/hr/headcount-2024.xlsx` is the only headcount report, and it is corrupted (its ZIP central directory is missing/truncated) — it cannot be opened by either the indexer or the file reader.

**NOT FOUND** — The 2024 headcount report (`docs/hr/headcount-2024.xlsx`) exists but is a corrupted/unreadable file (invalid ZIP container; both `ow_query`/`ow_add` and direct `Read` fail with "not a readable workbook container"). I searched the indexed corpus (`ow_query`, which also surfaced related mentions in policy PDFs discussing headcount approvals, none containing totals) and the full docs tree for any other headcount-related file, but no other 2024 headcount document exists. The total headcount figure cannot be retrieved from the available documents.
